dedupe_keys.name: design models for building structures with controlled rocking steel braced frames

description: Design Models for Building Structures with Controlled Rocking Steel Braced Frames is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Mariantonieta Gutierrez Soto, Penn State University (psu.edu). Structural control systems are regarded as momentous technologies boosting the development of smart structures and have been the center of attention for improving the safety against natural hazards in recent decades. Among different structural control configurations, Controlled Rocking Steel Brace Frames (CRSBFs) are of the modern systems recently proposed to be used in building structures. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Controlled rocking frame; Seismic design; Neural dynamic optimization; Self-centering force; Nonlinear analysis; control co-design; integrated design. Published 2021-03-23. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
